name: Homebase Orchestrator
description: Multi-agent task orchestration package. Wires the agent roster to a coordination queue with workspace events, retry, and report-back.
rationale: Multi-agent package: ~1h setup to import agent roster and configure wakeup queues; ~15 orchestration decisions per session (delegate / dispatch / wait / reply / retry); high notification volume during active work; user moves between canvas, chat, and automation board.
